excluded: complete TCP conformance or congestion recovery
SYN timeout history and timestamp extensions
delayed ACK, no-flight persist, fast retransmit and recovery
universal output/refinement proof and independent data implementation evidence

TX-HISTORY.interpretation: Record last transmission time for each finite in-flight data octet and FIN. A timer retransmission includes only the oldest contiguous prefix whose octets have aged at least the current pre-backoff RTO; retransmitted bytes receive the current clock. If oldest byte/FIN is not yet eligible, wait for its deadline without backoff or false emission.

TX-SCOPE.interpretation: 16 explicit per-octet timestamps move with the cumulative ACK queue. MSS=4, one timer, FIN has its own timestamp. Immediate handshake responses and SYN timeout history remain outside this new ledger. Existing RTT estimator, connection states and serial arithmetic are reused.
